test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 04 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate idiom to fill in the blank.

Rajat is known for his notorious nature. He will be friendly to your face but likes ____________.

options.text: to stab you in the back
to paint the whole town red
to get all bent out of the shape

solution:
The correct answer is: **'****to stab you in the back****'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"to stab you in the back"** means to betray someone who trusts you. (पीठ में छुरा घोंपना)

 
 
• **Example: **Despite their friendship, he stabbed him in the back by revealing his secrets.
 
 
 
• Rajat is known for his notorious nature. He will be friendly to your face but likes to stab you in the back. This means Rajat pretends to be friendly but actually betrays people. (राजत अपने चेहरे पर दोस्ताना दिखता है लेकिन पीठ में छुरा घोंपता है)

**​**Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **To blow his trumpet **(अपनी बड़ाई करना): To boast about one's own achievements.

 
 
• **Example:** He never misses an opportunity **to blow his own trumpet**.
 
 
 
• **To paint the whole town red **(जश्न मनाना): To go out and enjoy oneself flamboyantly.
 
 
• **Example: **After winning the match, the team decided **to paint the whole town red**.
 
 
 
• **To get all bent out of shape** (नाराज होना): To get very angry or upset.
 
 
• **Example:** He **got all bent out of shape** when he heard the news.
